name: Toast
description: Toast sells restaurants an all-in-one system: point-of-sale software, handheld and countertop hardware, online ordering, payroll and marketing tools, and, most importantly, the card payments that run through it. About 180,000 restaurant locations use it (2026-06-30), processing $215 billion of card volume over the trailing 12 months. It earns money three ways: a monthly software subscription, a cut of every card payment (fintech, 82% of revenue but only about a 23% gross margin because most of it passes through as processing costs) and a small hardware/services line that is sold at a loss to win the payments customer. Roughly 70% of gross profit comes from payments, not software.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not source-checked (the sub-industry was created in 2023, see classification-misfits.json). SEC SIC code is 7374 (Computer Processing & Data Preparation).

businessLines.name: Financial technology solutions
businessLines.how: A percentage of every card payment processed at Toast locations, recorded as gross revenue with interchange and network costs in cost of revenue; growth follows same-location sales and new locations.
businessLines.description: Payment processing on Toast's system plus Toast Capital loan servicing (loans originated by a third-party bank).

businessLines.name: Subscription services
businessLines.how: Monthly fees per location and per module (POS, payroll, marketing and others) under contracts of 12 to 36 months, recognized ratably.
businessLines.description: SaaS restaurant software applications on 12 to 36 month terms.

businessLines.name: Hardware and professional services
businessLines.how: One-time sale of equipment and onboarding services, priced below cost in H1 2026 to win subscription and payments customers.
businessLines.description: Terminals, tablets, handhelds and accessories (net of returns) and installation/professional services.
